subject: pinecone-hooded woodland creature
requested_medium: carved botanical sculpture and moss textile
art_direction: 松果鳞片形成小客人的大兜帽，苔绒身体与一枚红叶胸扣，坐姿温厚。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Build a woodland creature with a large hood made from overlapping pinecone scales and a small moss-textile body tucked beneath it. The face is round and reserved, with short hands holding the knees in a seated pose. Attach one terracotta-red leaf at the chest like a simple clasp. Render the scales as carved wood with varied thickness, contrasting with the soft moss fibers. Use a warm parchment studio field and low side light. Keep the body friendly and compact, without spines, a realistic hedgehog face, or elaborate forest surroundings. Square 1024x1024. Keep the complete central silhouette within a circular crop, occupying about 70% of the canvas. Original design; no lettering, logos, or watermark.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
